rules.D_OR_FAILURE: Previous close outside completed London/NY opening range, current close reclaims inside
rules.E_MICRO_PULLBACK: Direction+EMA20 hold, one small counter candle, then close through its extreme
rules.F_FAILED_AUCTION: Wick sweeps known 20-bar extreme and reclaims, rejection wick >= 35% of range
rules.G_RANGE_REVERSION: RANGE regime, touch outer 15% of prior 20-bar envelope, then close back inside it
rules.H_STRUCTURAL_RETEST: Prior BOS within 1–3 bars, retest its old swing level within 0.15 ATR, trend agrees
rules.I_EXHAUSTION: Prior RSI <=30/ >=70, favorable RSI change >= 3, reversal body >= 0.25 ATR
rules.J_EXPANSION_ACCEPTANCE: Prior close broke a preceding 20-bar extreme, current close >=0.1 ATR farther than old level, ATR ratio >=1.35
rules.K_SESSION_ADAPTATION: LONDON trend-aligned four-bar break, otherwise NEW_YORK opening-range failure
rules.L_TARGET_FEASIBILITY: Four-bar breakout with known forward obstacle >=1 planned R
rules.L_NO_ROOM_ABLATION: Identical L setup and risk, omit only the forward-obstacle test
